category_asymmetry.reason: Claude session relationships are flat: a project directory groups top-level transcripts and there is no parent/child rollout graph to model, so this category cannot exist for Claude. See cancellai-provider-claude/src/session.rs (E05-S03) and cancellai-provider-codex/src/graph.rs (E05-S04).

Not structural - a freshly written rollout is perfectly representable. The corpus simply never gained one. Recorded as a gap rather than silently tolerated; E22-S04's direct retention coverage is the nearer fix, and a codex-active-data fixture remains a candidate.
Not structural - an unrecognized top-level entry under ~/.claude is equally possible. The corpus covers the Codex side only; recorded as a gap so it stays visible.
